categories.evidence: Has the Validation label and alters block-index traversal and error handling in ActivateBestChain.
categories.rationale: Prevents redundant block-index traversals and duplicate log messages when handling invalid blocks. In ActivateBestChain, redundant calls to SetBlockFailureFlags and RecalculateBestHeader are consolidated into InvalidBlockFound, representing a modest cleanup of the error-handling path.
